required.provenance: Exact reviewed source, Azure VM/OS/data-disk identity and empty baseline; initializer journal and both immutable custody versions.
required.dashboard: New Basic authentication works, old fails with 401, then new works again; public and direct gateway paths.
required.database: Every LOGIN role inventoried without password attributes; new password works and old is rejected with password-auth failure over a password-checked TCP path.
required.hs256: Fresh challenge tokens signed with each key, identical current claims, accepted new and rejected old at every active Auth/REST/Storage/Realtime consumer; derived API tokens separately tested.
required.es256: Fresh challenge tokens signed with each EC key, identical current claims; new accepted and old rejected at each active consumer. Public JWKS contains no old kid/key or oct/private material.
required.sessions: No old Auth sessions, refresh tokens, MFA/provider tokens or one-time tokens imported. Separately approved exact-version old/new session fixtures prove refresh behavior; no broad token export.
required.storage_s3: New SigV4 read-only request succeeds, old yields SignatureDoesNotMatch or InvalidAccessKeyId; object-byte fixtures need explicit approval.
required.encryption: Fresh Realtime GCM, ECB compatibility, secret_key_base, pg-meta and intrinsic pgsodium material; source/consumer mapping, private inequality and fresh encryption/decryption exercise. Never call this a login test.
required.inactive: Supavisor/functions/MinIO/Logflare and opaque keys disabled: effective Compose configuration AND no running container/listener/route; generated unused secrets are still fresh.
required.external: Explicit reachable SMTP/OAuth/OpenAI/control-plane/operator credential assessment and issuer revocation evidence where applicable; blank current settings alone are insufficient.
required.old_containment: Approved NSG denies, stopped services and ARM deallocated state; both old IPs/hostname and private/lateral fresh connections fail during and after all probes; retained disks/escrow unchanged.
required.public_activation: Separate approved HTTPS/egress plan, actual NoReuse hostname, TLS, issuer and mail/webhook suppression; public path tests repeat after activation.
required.independent_review: Security and QA reviewers reconcile every consumer row against exact-source evidence; partial probe PASS never closes PD-3.
